description: This file defines the FrameTree class and related classes for managing browser frames, browsing contexts, WebSocket events, and worker debuggers within Firefox. It handles frame creation, navigation, WebSocket communication, and worker lifecycle events.

classes.name: FrameTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchy of browser frames, browsing contexts, WebSocket events, and worker debuggers.

classes.name: IsolatedWorld
classes.description: Represents an isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a single browser frame, manages its execution contexts, WebSocket events, and navigation state.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a dedicated web worker associated with a frame, manages messaging and lifecycle.

methods.name: setInitScripts
methods.description: Sets scripts to evaluate on new document creation in isolated worlds.

methods.name: frameForBrowsingContext
methods.description: Returns the Frame object associated with a given browsing context.

methods.name: frameForDocShell
methods.description: Returns the Frame object associated with a given docShell.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns an array of all frames in the frame tree.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and references for the FrameTree instance.
